newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Advance says won't probe share rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Advance says won't probe share rise.

text.p: Advance Bank Australia Ltd chairman Jim Service said the bank had considered requesting the suspension of trading in its shares on Friday, when its share price rose sharply on merger rumours.
St George Bank Ltd earlier unveiled a A$2.65 billion plan to merge with Advance. Service said the bank would not be investigating the share price movement on Friday.

"The board at one stage seriously considered asking the Australian Stock Exchange, but I was advised both by my professional consultants and my lawyers that this course was not appropriate," Service told reporters.
Advance Bank shares jumped 18 cents to A$6.28 last Friday and gained a further 57 cents to A$6.85 on Monday.
St George Bank shares closed 40 cents lower at A$8.55 on Monday, after rising two cents last Friday.
